scientific_limitations: Athermal overdamped four-state Markov run/pause process with constant, equal run and pause exit rates.
Infinite alternating-sign classification; not a classification of any isolated negative lag below the threshold.
Weak-reversal signals may be exponentially small; no claim of laboratory detectability or of full spatial distribution.
An independent mathematical and literature-priority audit has not been performed.
title: A sharp oscillatory-memory boundary for a run–pause particle in a harmonic trap
